zh.about: An optional second model with about 100 Mandarin voices that sound clearly better than the 8 built-in ones. It is a ~330 MB download and uses more GPU memory. English voices stay as they are.
zh.installed: Installed: the Chinese voice list shows its voices.
zh.not_installed: Not installed: Chinese books use the 8 built-in voices.
zh.downloading_start: Downloading about {total} MB… this can take a few minutes.
zh.confirm_remove: Remove Kokoro v1.1-zh? Chinese books go back to the built-in voices. Books already converted keep their audio.
sample.error: Could not play the voice sample.
sample.preparing: Preparing sample… the first one also starts the voice engine, which can take up to a minute
clean.heading: Clean a book
ocr.label: OCR (PDF only)
ocr.title: PDF only. Auto: OCR when the PDF is a scan. Always: OCR every page (garbled text layer, partly scanned book). Never: the PDF's own text only.
ocr.hint: OCR reads scanned PDFs. Pick a PDF to choose a mode; EPUB and TXT files have their own text, so they need no OCR.
clean.empty: Nothing here. Add a book above.
convert.heading: Convert a cleaned book
convert.note: Only for a .std.epub that is already cleaned (from the command line, or edited in Sigil). To convert an original book, use the Clean page. Books approved there appear below too.
convert.approved_empty: No approved books yet. Approve one on the Clean page, or upload a cleaned book above.
library.heading: Library
confirm.cancel: Cancel this conversion? Finished chapters stay in the library; approving again resumes where it stopped.
confirm.discard: Discard this cleaned book? The uploaded file and the cleaned version are deleted.
